root_cause: The rule that every error is registered and fixed by the agent existed only as Loop Constitution text and per-incident practice. Nothing in the agent preflight made it visible or required for skills, so a new skill could be added without any registration or self-fix duty and the gap would stay silent.
prevention_rule: The mandatory chat-learning preflight loads brain/policies/powerhouse-incident-register-and-self-fix-v1.json, fails closed on policy drift, fails when a skill outside the loop_debt_baseline lacks the INCIDENT_PROTOCOL marker, and reports baseline skills as visible loop debt in incident_self_fix.

evidence.red_phase: On the base commit the new test cannot import evaluateIncidentSelfFix and fails.
evidence.local_targeted_regressions: 7 new tests pass; 161 existing skill, preflight, system-map and learning tests pass.
evidence.preflight_after_change: READY, 99 sources, 67653 bytes of 256000; 41 skills, 1 with protocol, 40 visible loop debt.

outcome.runtime_agents_covered: NO: edge functions and Make scenarios have no uniform file to scan; their duty is policy only
